question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
-- Build the report with month names
WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    order_id
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered' 
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
),
months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num, 'January' AS month_name UNION ALL 
  SELECT 2, 'February' UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'March' UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'April' 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'May' UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'June' UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'July' UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'August' 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'September' UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'October' UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'November' UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'December'
)
SELECT 
  m.month_name,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year = 2016 THEN d.order_id END), 0) AS "2016",
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN d.order_id END), 0) AS "2017",
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year = 2018 THEN d.order_id END), 0) AS "2018"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN delivered_orders d ON m.month_num = d.month
GROUP BY m.month_num, m.month_name
ORDER BY m.month_num
